tasks.title: Card Interaction Improvements - Clickable Cards with Hover States
tasks.description: Enhance topic card interactions by making entire cards clickable to open the drawer, implementing hover states with pointer cursor and subtle animations, while maintaining full accessibility standards for keyboard navigation.
tasks.details:
1. **Make Entire Card Clickable**: Refactor topic card components to wrap the entire card content in a clickable container that opens the TopicDetailDrawer. Use semantic HTML with proper button or link elements, ensuring the click area covers the full card dimensions while maintaining existing action chip functionality through event propagation control (stopPropagation on chip clicks).

2. **Implement Hover States**: Add CSS hover states that change the cursor to pointer on card hover. Implement subtle visual feedback including: slight elevation increase (box-shadow), gentle scale transform (scale(1.02)), and background color shift. Use Tailwind CSS utilities like `hover:shadow-lg hover:scale-[1.02] hover:bg-gray-50 cursor-pointer` with smooth transitions (transition-all duration-150).

3. **Subtle Hover Animations**: Implement smooth micro-interactions using CSS transitions or Framer Motion. Add gentle bounce or lift effects on hover with proper easing curves (ease-out). Ensure animations are performant by using transform properties and avoiding layout-triggering properties. Consider reduced motion preferences with `prefers-reduced-motion` media queries.

4. **Accessibility Implementation**: Ensure keyboard navigation works seamlessly - cards should be focusable with Tab key and open drawer on Enter/Space keypress. Implement proper focus indicators that meet WCAG contrast requirements. Add ARIA labels like `aria-label="Open topic details for [topic title]"` and `role="button"` for screen readers. Ensure focus management transfers correctly to the drawer when opened.

5. **Integration with Existing Components**: Coordinate with the simplified card design (Task 34) and chip-based actions (Task 35) to ensure hover states don't conflict with action chip interactions. Maintain the minimal design approach while adding interactive enhancements.

Test keyboard navigation - Tab to focus cards, Enter/Space to open drawer, proper focus indicators visible. Validate screen reader announcements with ARIA labels and role attributes. Test interaction with action chips - ensure chip clicks don't trigger card click (event propagation). Verify accessibility compliance with WCAG guidelines for focus states and contrast ratios.
